title: 第8章 八部天龙荒古祭台第10章 紫色狐狸丹道三千
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 无数的嗜血幽冥蝠，疯狂地朝著苏辰狠狠吞来。
“太臭了。”
臭气熏天。
苏辰满脸的厌恶，看著四周涌来的一只只嗜血幽冥蝠，头顶上空凝聚出血轮，里面有著龙象虚影奔腾嘶吼。
“血轮！”
看著不远处凝聚出血轮的苏辰，王泉和王语音等人彻底傻眼了，谁都没有想到，已经被废掉血轮的苏辰，为何能够重新施展血轮。
这是什么血轮？
整个盘幽城的人都知道，苏家觉醒的血轮为剑，只要是核心弟子，无一例外，包括苏辰在內。
现在呢？
看著苏辰头顶上空浮现的血轮，除了懵逼就是震惊。
一声龙吟，一声象吼。
九条虚幻龙影和九头虚幻象影从血轮咆哮而出，苏辰施展九龙九象术，开始朝著四周狠狠地轰击而去。
哪怕是斩杀嗜血幽冥蝠，也绝对不会吞服。
这种妖兽实在太臭了，连苏辰都无法忍受，只能选择放弃吞噬。
龙象血轮笼罩著苏辰。
轰轰轰！
密密麻麻的嗜血幽冥蝠，疯狂地轰击著龙象血轮，不断地被撞击下，苏辰嘴角开始慢慢往外渗血。
眼神越来越凝重，继续这样下去的话，恐怕会给自己带来很大的麻烦。
手里出现葬劫笔。
塔灵送给他的这件至宝，有著很大的限制，先不说境界限制，单单是每次自己动用葬劫笔，都会消耗灵魂。
在天罚森林，自己一旦灵魂消耗遭受重创，会有很大的危险。
匯聚灵魂涌入葬劫笔之中。
朝著四周开始挥舞起来，一笔笔绘製。
顿时间。
雷鸣嘶吼，霸道无比的雷劫在葬劫笔下快速地匯聚，形成范围內的绝对禁忌天劫镇压。
砰！
砰！
涌入葬劫范围內的嗜血幽冥蝠，身体瞬间爆裂，化作一团团血雾，就算是如此，嗜血幽冥蝠依然疯狂地轰击，宛如飞蛾扑火一般，从四面八方匯聚而来。
被屠杀的嗜血幽冥蝠越来越多，匯聚的鲜血成河。
“过去。”
看到苏辰能够抵挡住嗜血幽冥蝠的攻击，王泉和王语音等人脸色顿时一喜，立刻朝著苏辰的方向快速移动。
满地的鲜血发出阵阵恶臭，苏辰实在无法忍受这股恶臭。
杀出去！
强行动用葬劫笔，不断地消耗灵魂，一旦消耗完灵魂之力，到时候不用嗜血幽冥蝠出手，单单是他自己就已经自灭了。
藉助葬劫笔，苏辰的速度加快，硬生生地杀出一条血路。
“苏辰，你不能见死不救。”
content_en:
Countless bloodthirsty Nether Bats savaged Su Chen crazily.
"It stinks."
The stench was overwhelming.
Su Chen's face was filled with disgust as he looked at the bloodthirsty nether bats swarming around him. A blood wheel formed above his head, and within it was a dragon elephant phantom running and roaring.
"Blood wheel!"
Looking at Su Chen who had condensed the blood wheel not far away, Wang Quan, Wang Yinxin and others were completely dumbfounded. No one thought that Su Chen, whose blood wheel had been abolished, could re-activate the blood wheel.
What kind of blood wheel is this?
Everyone in Panyou City knows that the awakened blood wheel of the Su family is a sword, and as long as they are core disciples, there is no exception, including Su Chen.
What now?
Seeing the blood wheel emerging above Su Chen's head, he was either confused or shocked.
A dragon roared and an elephant roared.
Nine illusory dragon shadows and nine illusory elephant shadows roared out from the blood wheel. Su Chen used the Nine Dragons and Nine Elephants technique and began to bombard the surroundings fiercely.
Even if it kills the bloodthirsty Nether Bat, it will never be swallowed.
This kind of monster was so smelly that even Su Chen couldn't bear it and had no choice but to give up swallowing it.
The dragon-elephant blood wheel enveloped Su Chen.
Boom boom boom!
The densely packed bloodthirsty nether bats frantically bombarded the dragon-elephant blood chakra. Being hit continuously, blood began to slowly ooze from the corners of Su Chen's mouth.
His eyes became more and more solemn, and if he continued like this, he might cause himself a lot of trouble.
A burial pen appeared in his hand.
This treasure given to him by the tower spirit has great restrictions. Not to mention the realm restrictions, just every time he uses the Burial Tribulation Pen, his soul will be consumed.
In the Forest of Heaven's Punishment, once your soul is consumed and you suffer severe damage, you will be in great danger.
Gathering souls poured into the Burial Tribulation Pen.
He started waving around, drawing one stroke at a time.
time.
Thunder roared, and the extremely domineering thunder tribulations quickly gathered under Zhan Jie's pen, forming an absolute taboo of heavenly tribulation suppression within the range.
Bang!
Bang!
The bodies of the bloodthirsty Nether Bats that poured into the area of ​​the Burial Tribulation exploded instantly and turned into clouds of blood mist. Even so, the Bloodthirsty Nether Bats still bombarded wildly, gathering from all directions like moths to a flame.
More and more bloodthirsty ghost bats were being slaughtered, and the blood gathered into a river.
"Past."
Seeing that Su Chen was able to resist the attack of the bloodthirsty Nether Bat, Wang Quan, Wang Yunyin and others suddenly became happy and immediately moved quickly in the direction of Su Chen.
The blood all over the ground gave off a stench, and Su Chen couldn't bear the stench.
Fight out!
Forcefully use the Burial Tribulation Pen to continuously consume souls. Once the power of the soul is consumed, he will have destroyed himself without the need for the bloodthirsty Nether Bat to take action.
With the help of the Burial Tribulation Pen, Su Chen increased his speed and cut a bloody path.
"Su Chen, you can't ignore death."
